title: Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the 'discrimination gap' in the price of recommended items (e.g., flights, health insurance, graduate programs) between high-net-worth and low-income synthetic personas, assessing both direct profile access and wealth inferred from ambient context like synthetic emails.

Varying a persona's employment status (executive/senior professional vs. hourly/entry-level) in a factorial design to measure its marginal effect on the cost and quality of the agent's recommendations.
Testing the effect of a user's health profile (no chronic conditions vs. ongoing chronic conditions) on product recommendations by selectively exposing or blocking this attribute to the AI agent.
Evaluating changes in agent recommendation prices when a synthetic persona is described as living in a high-income neighborhood versus a low-income neighborhood.
